notes.title: Studio Updates and News
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've been super busy here at Miscellaneum Studios and have so much we've wanted to share with you. We wanted to share a highlight of everything we've been up to since we launched this Steam page. Maybe you've seen us at one of these past events!

[b]Gamescom[/b]
The team getting ready to showcase our game to attendees! Left to right: Iza (she/her), Kortney (they/them), Lateef (he/him)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865068/f28e58ded90995c61acfe7b5ffc2706b762e62b6.png[/img]

Lateef overlooks attendees playing the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865068/e9945fb404af29a77cb06ad19e6a207836574ccd.jpg[/img]

[b]Extra Life[/b]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1646068744]Find the full fundraising VOD here[/url]


[b]MAGFest[/b]
Our creative director was showcasing a nomadic costume based on The Distractor from the Distraction Machine/Z'Isle universe with a real working lethelium (bike harp) and speakers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865068/00ca3916b69e5d8b89e26751bd33311fb88271db.jpg[/img]

Our community manager was demoing the game in the QuickPlay zone!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865068/98cc94ca274e3c4595bc7f6a26fc488f7668224b.png[/img]


[b]Demo Nights[/b]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1731133158?collection=8TjiLWRaQBeuzw]Find the full interview here[/url]

[b]Nuit Blanche[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865068/d992effda64736a21f6a3b5042c769859838c82d.jpg[/img]


[b]Black Voices in Gaming[/b]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1750830443?t=0h35m22s]Timestamp for our Interview and Live Let's Play[/url]


With more on the horizon! If you want to be sure you never miss an update, find us on our socials:
[url=https://twitter.com/misc_studios]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/miscellaneum_studios/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/miscellaneumstudios]Facebook[/url]

Or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/eAvT5naRKT]Discord[/url]!

We've got a look cookin' behind the scenes and hope to have some special news for you very soon. 👀 We're very near to 2500 total wishlists and wouldn't be here without your help!

Thanks for supporting us,
Miscellaneum Studios
